visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair sleeps soundly under a white duvet in a bright, minimalist bedroom. A small white long-haired dog lies next to her. She wakes up, yawns, and checks a black smartphone that displays the time 09:51. The setting is clean with white walls and a simple calendar. (2) In a well-lit bathroom or dressing area, the woman stands before a mirror wearing a blue-striped pajama set and a white fluffy headband. She holds a gold and beige bottle of Dior Prestige BB cream. She pumps the product onto her forearm and then applies small dots to her cheek, blending them with her fingertips. (3) A vertical split-screen appears, labeled 'Before' and 'After', showing the immediate brightening effect of the cream on her right cheek. She continues to apply the product to her forehead and chin, her skin appearing smoother and more even-toned. (4) The woman quickly changes into a white sports bra and grey sweatpants. She puts on a matching grey zip-up hoodie and grabs a quilted silver metallic tote bag from a white sideboard. (5) On a sun-drenched urban sidewalk, she walks confidently while holding her phone. She wears the grey tracksuit and silver bag, looking at the camera. The background features modern glass-fronted commercial buildings and sparse green trees. (6) She enters a modern gym with floor-to-ceiling windows. She sits on a green mat, stretching her legs with her eyes closed, then sits on a workout bench. Her complexion looks glowing and natural in the soft indoor light.

The vocal is clean with high spectral clarity. A faint electronic chime or vibration sound from a phone marks the end of his phrase. (2) A synthesized rhythmic pop beat with a BPM of approximately 105 kicks in. A high-frequency 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies the first visual cut to the makeup application. The BGM features a prominent female vocal singing in English with a bright, airy quality. (3) During the makeup and outfit transitions, several percussive 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are used as intentional editing markers. The BGM maintains a consistent, upbeat energy with a strong electronic kick drum and synth chords, creating a lively lifestyle atmosphere. (4) The BGM continues as the dominant audio layer throughout the walking and gym segments. The female vocals and rhythmic beat persist with no significant environmental or background noise, suggesting a highly produced master track suitable for social media promotion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote Dior Prestige BB cream by demonstrating its effectiveness and convenience within a high-speed 'Get Ready With Me' (GRWM) morning routine. The video targets active women by showing how the product provides a radiant 'no-makeup' look suitable for both city life and gym workouts.
